اسرنديا (form IIIq)
# اِسْرَنْدَيَا (israndayā) /is.ran.da.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْرَنْدَى (israndā)
# اِسْرَنْدِيَا (israndiyā) /is.ran.di.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْرَنْدَى (israndā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
